title.en: AN ACT DECLARING ALL PERSONS IN ARMS AGAINST THE AUTHORITY OF THE UNITED STATES IN THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS, AND ALL PERSONS AIDING OR ABETTING THEM, ON THE FIRST DAY OF APRIL, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND ONE, OR THEREAFTER, INELIGIBLE TO HOLD OFFICE.
title.orig: AN ACT DECLARING ALL PERSONS IN ARMS AGAINST THE AUTHORITY OF THE UNITED STATES IN THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS, AND ALL PERSONS AIDING OR ABETTING THEM, ON THE FIRST DAY OF APRIL, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND ONE, OR THEREAFTER, INELIGIBLE TO HOLD OFFICE.
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố tất cả những người cầm vũ khí chống lại chính quyền Hoa Kỳ tại quần đảo Philippines và tất cả những người hỗ trợ hoặc xúi giục họ vào ngày 1 tháng 4 năm 1901 hoặc sau đó không đủ điều kiện giữ chức vụ công
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้บุคคลทั้งหมดที่ถืออาวุธต่อต้านอำนาจสหรัฐอเมริกาในหมู่เกาะฟิลิปปินส์และบุคคลทั้งหมดที่ให้ความช่วยเหลือหรือยุยงพวกเขาในวันที่ 1 เมษายน ค.ศ.1901 หรือหลังจากนั้นไม่มีคุณสมบัติเข้ารับตำแหน่งทางการ
title.id: Undang-Undang yang Menyatakan Bahwa Semua Orang yang Berada dalam Senjata Melawan Otoritas Amerika Serikat di Kepulauan Filipina dan Semua Orang yang Membantu atau Mendorong Mereka pada Tanggal 1 April 1901 atau Setelahnya Tidak Memenuhi Syarat untuk Menduduki Jabatan Publik
title.ms: Akta yang Mengisytiharkan Bahawa Semua Orang yang Bersenjata Melawan Kuasa Amerika Syarikat di Kepulauan Filipina dan Semua Orang yang Membantu atau Mendorong Mereka pada 1 April 1901 atau Selepasnya Tidak Layak Memegang Jawatan Awam

text.en:
All persons who on the first day of April, nineteen hundred and one, or thereafter, shall be in arms
against the authority and sovereignty of the United States in the Philippine Islands, and all persons aiding or
abetting them on or after said date, are hereby declared ineligible to hold any office of honor, trust, or profit
in the Philippine Islands.

Section fifteen of the Civil Service Act is hereby amended by inserting after the last word of the
said section the following: "Provided, however, That no person shall be eligible for examination or
appointment under the provisions of this Act who shall be, on or after the first day of April, nineteen hundred
and one, in arms against the authority of the United States in the Philippine Islands, or who shall thereafter
give aid and comfort to the enemies of the United States so in arms."

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, January 26, 1901.
